data_description.done_message: Optional template sent when the alert clears.
data_description.data: Optional key/values passed to the notify service (e.g. priority, channel).
data_description.numeric_comparator: Fire when the sensor value is below or above the threshold.

data_description.text_state: The alert is active while the sensor state exactly matches this value.

no_entities.title: Alert has no active entities

turn_on.name: Reset (re-arm)
turn_on.description: Removes the acknowledgement so the alert notifies again while still firing.

turn_off.name: Acknowledge
turn_off.description: Acknowledges the alert, silencing further notifications until it clears.

toggle.name: Toggle acknowledgement
toggle.description: Toggles the acknowledged state of the alert.
